title: Every core block renders in both site themes: a custom page draws through the same sections on Frequency and Bold, and a guard fails when a block or class lacks a render in either

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-11: 'If a user switches, each core block should easily display in the new theme.' Second slice of three (names, block parity, editor rails). ADR-1727

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-11. site-page plans a custom page into the site page sections whatever the theme; Frequency dresses them with FREQUENCY_PAGE_CSS (house look), Bold with MENSWORK_PAGE_CSS. The calendar page is the public calendar in both. site-block-themes.test.ts lists the blocks that keep the Space page's own render (page and Home), fails on any unlisted unsectioned palette block or stale listing, on a theme-gated page plan, and on any drawn or styled mw- class missing from either sheet.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const sp=r('components/sites/site-page.tsx');if(!/const mwBlocks: MwBlock\[\] \| null =\s*customPage\s*\?/.test(sp))miss.push('a custom page is not planned in both themes');if(!/!skin && <style>\{FREQUENCY_PAGE_CSS\}<\/style>/.test(sp))miss.push('the Frequency page sheet is not applied');if(!/export const FREQUENCY_PAGE_CSS/.test(r('components/sites/frequency-page-css.ts')))miss.push('no Frequency page sheet');const t=r('lib/sites/site-block-themes.test.ts');if(!/PAGE_OWN_RENDER/.test(t)||!/HOME_OWN_RENDER/.test(t)||!/missing from FREQUENCY_PAGE_CSS/.test(t))miss.push('the parity guard is gone');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-894: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
